id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

path.description: File path of the source file

statementReachedCount.description:
Key is a unique integer generated by the instrumentation to identify each statement.
Value represents the number of times the statement has been reached by the Istanbul code coverage tool when
running tests.

branchReachedCount.description:
Key is a unique integer generated by the instrumentation to identify each branch.
Value {@link IstanbulBranchReachCounts} contains a counts array, representing the number of times each of
the branches has been reached by the Istanbul code coverage tool when running tests. For example, if the
branch is a switch statement, the counts array length would be the number of cases in the switch statement.

functionReachedCount.description:
Key is a unique integer generated by the instrumentation to identify each function.
Value represents the number of times the function has been reached by the Istanbul code coverage tool when
running tests.

statementMap.description:
Statement map used by Istanbul coverage tool to map unique ids that are embedded into instrumented code representing
statements, to the file locations in uninstrumented code.

branchMap.description:
Branch map used by Istanbul coverage tool to map unique ids that are embedded into instrumented code representing
branches, to the file locations in uninstrumented code.

functionMap.description:
Function map used by Istanbul coverage tool to map unique ids that are embedded into instrumented code representing
functions, to the file locations in uninstrumented code.

title: IstanbulCoverageFileResult keeps track of which lines were reached in the last test execution.
